svg.title: Known-best n=68: descriptive contact census
svg.desc: House rendering of known-best n=68 with dashed graph edges for contacts detected at angle tolerance 1e-06 radians and contact tolerance 0.001. Lines join square centres or centres to walls; they are descriptive graph incidence, not exact physical contact loci or rigidity certificates.

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Exact rational corners from the retained centered source, checked with exact predicates at the full rational side. Drawing feasibility does not assign the imported result's confirmation rung. No optimality, rigidity or human oversight claim.

g.data-semantics: tolerance-qualified graph edges, not exact contact loci
